table.note: no table: no column was matched to a sample; agent: The featureCounts file holds whole-number counts per gene (symbols in column 1, nine count columns in columns 2-10), so these are raw read counts. No sample is given in sources, because the column names (e.g. "BAM:N1:GE_96h", "BAM:N3:GE_96h", "BAM:N5:GE_96h") only name the treatment group and repeat for each replicate. They do not identify which column belongs to which GSM, and the column order alone cannot do that.
